senate.description: Cap increase on a grant under the emerging contaminants grant program

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; increasing the cap on a grant under the emerging contaminants grant program; amending Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 446A.082, subdivision 4.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 446A.082, subdivision 4, is amended to read:

Subd. 4.
Grant amount.
The grant amount for an eligible project under this program shall be for an amount up to [-50-][+ 80+] percent of the eligible as-bid project cost up to [-$5,000,000-][+ $12,000,000+], minus the amount of federal emerging contaminant funds the project receives under section 446A.081, subdivision 9, paragraph (b), clause (4), or other federal emerging contaminant funds.
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; increasing the cap on a grant under the emerging contaminants grant program; amending Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 446A.082, subdivision 4.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 446A.082, subdivision 4, is amended to read:

Subd. 4.
Grant amount.
The grant amount for an eligible project under this program shall be for an amount up to 80 percent of the eligible as-bid project cost up to $12,000,000, minus the amount of federal emerging contaminant funds the project receives under section 446A.081, subdivision 9, paragraph (b), clause (4), or other federal emerging contaminant funds.
